story.title: How it all started
story.content:
In 2020, we realized that the humble hyperlink hadn't evolved in two decades. While the rest of the web became intelligent, responsive, and secure, links remained static strings of text. We built Dragolink to change that.

Today, a link is the most critical intersection between your brand and your audience. We believe that every click should be protected by enterprise-grade security, tracked with microscopic precision, and routed intelligently. Our team of distributed engineers works around the clock to ensure our infrastructure can handle billions of redirects with zero latency.
